Kennel doors and some small changes
The desk is glad to help at midday
Travelers at Aurelia Skyways should review pet travel arrangements before they arrive at the skyport.

Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Please bring your animal's travel records, carrying gear, and comfort items in ready order. The desk checks each journey as a shared responsibility, with care plans shaped to the species, temperament, and comfort of the animal. Staff will review kennel fit, ventilation, feeding needs, and any movement concerns with calm attention, then guide the next step in plain language.

If a concern appears during review, the matter is handled through a calm stepwise process. This keeps the animal's welfare in view and helps travelers prepare without confusion. For this reason, visitors should keep papers complete, keep carriers secure, and arrive prepared to discuss any special handling needs. The same careful method applies to routine checks and to any later adjustment that may be needed for a safe journey.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before boarding so the team can confirm the travel plan and direct you to the correct desk for help.
